source_quote: And the bedrock of this entire platform is something they call OneLake. OneLake is fundamental to understanding how the ontology actually executes. It is the shared data foundation. Like a massive hard drive for the company. The architectural philosophy here is that different teams within an organization, data scientists, financial analysts, operations managers, can all work with the exact same underlying govern data. But using their own tools. Exactly. They access it through different analytical compute engines depending on their specific needs.
